listings.extraDetails: Agency ad (same wording as rent.com.au): "Private entrance", "Large fully fenced yard", "Covered alfresco overlooking spacious and private garden", "One undercover car park and extra driveway parking". Shops: "close to all amenities, including supermarkets, schools, the Redcliffe Peninsula, Mango Hill train line & the iconic Westfield North Lakes". No ad mentions pets, stairs, which level the duplex is on, or a bus stop. The agency ad says "Available from Monday 19 Oct" and inspections are "View by appointment"; the booking page and TenantApp show no inspection times yet.
listings.notes: The ad names only "Leasing Department". On the agency's website that contact links to the "Property Management Team" page, whose only email link ("Email Property Management") is mcgrathnorthlakes@mail.inspectrealestate.com.au. That is McGrath's Inspect Real Estate enquiry inbox: TenantApp's copy of the ad gives the same address for "Leasing Department", and the enquiry form on the agency's listing page sends to it. If you would rather write to a named person, Jane Longmuir's title is "Leasing Manager". Her email link is on her profile and on https://mcgrathmb.com.au/north-lakes/property-management/. The office inbox, northlakes@mcgrath.com.au, is on every page of the site and on McGrath's national office page (https://www.mcgrath.com.au/offices/north-lakes-a0v5g000002CSVjAAO). Copying northlakes@ into the email would be a sensible backup. The ad's phone number, (07) 3888 0098, is correct, and all the staff share it. Web searches found no domain.com.au or homely.com.au ad for this duplex, and Homely's Rothwell rentals list doesn't include it. My tools can't search or open realestate.com.au, so I couldn't check it. Domain has a profile for this "Leasing Department" agent (https://www.domain.com.au/real-estate-agent/leasing-department-1911826/), but I didn't open it because Domain blocks automated access.

listings.extraDetails: Agency ad (same text as rent.com.au, TenantApp and Homely): "All studios are unfurnished with a private balcony or courtyard". Shops: "Nundah Village - 800m or a 10 mins walk". Buses: "Closest Bus Stop approximately 600 metres" (the ad also says "just 500m"), "Bus Route 300, 310 (City express)", every 30 minutes from 6am to 8.30pm. Nundah train station is 700 m away. Also "Laundry facility on site by use of gold coins" and "Electricity is a your expense"; there is no car space. Pets: 7/17's own ads say nothing. The sister ad for studio 5/17 (same building, same agency: https://rentmyproperty.com.au/rental/5-17-thomas-st-nundah-qld-4012/) says "-No Pets" and "(Single Living Only)". Floor: not stated for unit 7. A property profile of the building (seen only as ratemyagent.com.au search-result text) says the "ground floor has 10 studio apartments and 1 one bedroom apartment", and Level 1 has 5 studios, 1 one-bedroom unit and 5 lofts with "internal stairs". No lift is mentioned. TenantApp shows an inspection on Wed 30 Sep, 1:00-1:15 pm.
listings.notes: Confirmed: rentals@rentmyproperty.com.au is published on the agency's own ad for 7/17 as a "Contact Rent My Property by Email" link, and TenantApp's copy of the ad gives the same address. The ad's phone number, +6131933450, is missing the 7: it is (07) 3193 3450. That number appears on the TenantApp ad and on TenantApp's Rent My Property page, and the agency's own ad shows it as "31933450". TenantApp pairs it with an older Carina address (866 Old Cleveland Road). The agency's current contact page doesn't list Carina or that number. The ad is filed under the Redcliffe office, which the contact page calls "Brisbane Northside to Sunshine Coast": 545 Oxley Ave, Redcliffe, phone (07) 3203 6500, info@rentmyproperty.com.au. The head-office line on the same page is (07) 3709 5555. No named property manager appears anywhere. Pets: expect a no-pets building. 5/17 says "No Pets", and web-search summaries of older, now-removed ads for units 1 and 19 also said no pets (not verified). Ask directly about a small indoor cat. The domain.com.au link is probably an older ad for this unit: the search snippet shows $300 a week, available 12 Feb 2025. Domain blocks automated fetching, so I couldn't check it, and I couldn't check realestate.com.au either. The ad is aimed at students and young professionals; the unit is a studio (1 bed, 1 bath, no parking). The enquiry link above is the agency's inspection booking page, because the listing page has no enquiry form. The agency's general contact form is at https://rentmyproperty.com.au/contact-us/.
